Test Scenario: Verify all core locators are initialized
Test Steps: 1. Instantiate LoginPage(page) 2. Check locator properties
Expected Result: usernameInput, passwordInput, submitButton, passwordToggle locators exist and are defined.

Test Scenario: Verify locator selector mappings match DOM elements
Test Steps: 1. Check selector matching for inputs and buttons
Expected Result: All mapped selectors resolve to visible DOM nodes without throwing locator resolution errors.

Test Scenario: Successful navigation to Login page
Test Steps: 1. Call await loginPage.goto() 2. Check URL and DOM load state
Expected Result: Page URL contains /login. domcontentloaded is reached, and Sign In form is displayed.

Test Scenario: Navigation with active session cookies
Test Steps: 1. Authenticate user 2. Call await loginPage.goto()
Expected Result: System redirects authenticated user to /admin/prescription or dashboard.

Test Scenario: Offline network resilience during navigation
Test Steps: 1. Disconnect network 2. Call await loginPage.goto()
Expected Result: Throws clear network navigation error or displays browser offline fallback.

Test Scenario: Valid provider login with correct credentials
Test Steps: 1. Call await loginPage.login(validUser, validPass) 2. Check URL change
Expected Result: Successful authentication; redirected away from /login; session tokens stored.

Test Scenario: Invalid password handling
Test Steps: 1. Call await loginPage.login(validUser, wrongPass) 2. Verify error message
Expected Result: Authentication fails; remains on /login; error toast/alert is displayed.

Test Scenario: Non-existent username
Test Steps: 1. Call await loginPage.login(fakeUser, password) 2. Verify error handling
Expected Result: System denies access with error message.

Test Scenario: Empty username and empty password submission
Test Steps: 1. Call await loginPage.login('', '') 2. Check form state
Expected Result: HTML5 validation or form error prevents submission; fields required.

Test Scenario: SQL injection and script string sanitization
Test Steps: 1. Enter injection in user 2. Enter script in pass 3. Submit
Expected Result: Payload safely escaped; authentication rejected without server errors.

Test Scenario: Verify default password state is masked
Test Steps: 1. Enter password 2. Call await loginPage.isPasswordMasked()
Expected Result: Returns true; input attribute type strictly equals 'password'.

Test Scenario: Verify return value after unmasking
Test Steps: 1. Toggle visibility 2. Call await loginPage.isPasswordMasked()
Expected Result: Returns false because input attribute type equals 'text'.

Test Scenario: Toggle from masked to unmasked plaintext
Test Steps: 1. Call await loginPage.togglePasswordVisibility() 2. Check type attribute
Expected Result: Input type switches from 'password' to 'text'. Plain text becomes visible.

Test Scenario: Toggle back from unmasked to masked
Test Steps: 1. Call await loginPage.togglePasswordVisibility() again 2. Check type attribute
Expected Result: Input type switches back from 'text' to 'password'. Characters re-masked.

Test Scenario: Rapid double-click toggle stability
Test Steps: 1. Rapidly click toggle icon twice
Expected Result: Input returns cleanly to initial masked state without UI glitching.

Test Scenario: Verify all core PrescriptionPage locators are initialized
Test Steps: 1. Instantiate PrescriptionPage(page) 2. Check locators existence
Expected Result: Locators (searchInput, todayTab, storyTab, noPatientCard, dateInput, etc.) are defined.

Test Scenario: Validate action bar locator selectors integrity
Test Steps: 1. Verify saveButton, printButton, endConsultationButton, sendToPharmacyButton
Expected Result: All action bar locators map correctly to visible interactive elements.

Test Scenario: Default navigation without query parameters
Test Steps: 1. Call await rxPage.goto() 2. Inspect loaded URL and page state
Expected Result: Navigates to /admin/prescription. Empty state 'No patient selected' is displayed.

Test Scenario: Navigation with patient ID query param (pid)
Test Steps: 1. Call await rxPage.goto('pid=333566') 2. Wait for todayTab visibility
Expected Result: Navigates to /admin/prescription?pid=333566. Clinical consultation inputs unlocked.

Test Scenario: Navigation with existing consultation ID (id and pid)
Test Steps: 1. Call await rxPage.goto('id=1024&pid=333566') 2. Check consultation state
Expected Result: Loads specific consultation draft or finalized record with saved data.

Test Scenario: Navigation with invalid/non-existent patient ID
Test Steps: 1. Call await rxPage.goto('pid=999999999') 2. Verify system response
Expected Result: System shows error toast or redirects to empty state gracefully.

Expected Result: Network call /patients/getPatients returns 200 OK. Cmdk dropdown populates results.

Test Scenario: Search patient by registered mobile number

Test Scenario: Search patient with non-existent query

Test Scenario: Search with special characters and leading/trailing spaces

Test Scenario: Successfully select first matching patient from dropdown

Test Scenario: Full search-and-select flow by patient name

Test Scenario: Full search-and-select flow by patient mobile
